messages:
maria: Quick sync — we're about to flip the launch sweep (search + retarget) at 9am PT. Need final call on budget pacing and creative swap. main ask: avoid spike that eats daily budget in first 2 hours.

leo: On it. Plan = 3-phase pacing: warmup (0-2h) 40% of projected hourly spend, ramp (2-8h) steady 100%, sustain (8h+) throttle to hit daily target. Will set dayparting and bid modulation.

taylor: Creative refresh ready — 3 headlines + 2 images per ad group. Recommend letting 1 control run for first 4 hours then auto-rotate winner. If we lock too early we lose signal.

ash: Measurement notes — make sure audience exclusion list includes last-7d converters + webinar registrants. Also remove overlap between site-retarget-14d and cart-abandon-7d to reduce duplicate exposure. Pulling predicted CPA from Looker now.

leo: Ads changes i'll push:
```
Campaign: Launch-Sweep-2026
Budget(day): 1200
AdGroups: search-core, search-longtail, retarget-broad, retarget-cart
Scripts:
- setBudget(campaignId=12345, daily=1200);
- setAdRotation(auto);
- applyBidAdj(time=09:00-11:00, multiplier=0.6, groups=all);
- applyBidAdj(time=11:00-17:00, multiplier=1.0);
```
I’ll stage via Editor, then push at 08:45.

maria: Good. Leo — can you add a hard cap rule so if CPC > $6 for search-core we reduce bids 20%? Last launch burned thru noisy queries.

leo: Yep. Adding automated rule and a slack alert. Rule: `IF avg_cpc > 6 AND conversions < 3 THEN decrease_bids 20% AND notify #marketing`.

ads-bot: Daily pacing report (yesterday): projected spend vs target: 1120/1200 (93%). Peak hour 10:00-11:00 was 32% of daily spend. Top queries: +generic term1, +brand-term, +competitor-term.

ash: Also — change retarget window: retarget-broad = 30d, cart = 7d but frequency cap = 3/day. Add rule to pause retarget if reach >50% overlap with search audience in same day.

ash: small ask for attribution: tag landing urls with utm_campaign=launch_sweep_05 and utm_content={creative_id}. Need QA before go.

taylor: I'll export creative IDs and put them in the sheet. Want to A/B test headline variants against control for first 24h.

maria: Ops checklist: 1) leo pushes changes 08:45 2) ash verifies GA event pings 08:50 3) taylor turns on creative rotation 09:00 4) tags confirmed. If any of these fail we hold launch.

leo: Copy. Pushing to staging now. Will post Editor diff in thread when ready.

leo: Editor diff: changed daily budget + bid adj + automated rule. snippet: `editor://diff/launch-sweep-2168009876` (preview link)

maria: Perfect. If the auto-rule triggers during warmup we should reduce ramp by 15% and extend warmup window to 4h. Add fallback?

leo: Added fallback policy: if rule fires within first 3h -> extend warmup to 4h and set multiplier to 0.5 for next hour. Also set rollback if CTR < 0.6% after 6h.

ash: I'll watch UTM inflow and event counts. If conversions < expected by 12:00 we'll throttle and reallocate to retarget where CPA is lower historically.

maria: Great. Final: everyone confirm by emoji. :eyes: :rocket:

taylor: :rocket:

leo: :thumbsup:

ash: :white_check_mark:

ads-bot: Alert scheduled: Launch-Sweep-2026 -> channel #marketing-notifs at 09:00 PT. Report cadence: 15m for first 2h, hourly thereafter.

maria: Thanks team — standing by in case we need to pause.
